outcomeDiff: No divergence on the three acceptance surfaces. Design improved over the PLAN sketch after round-1 findings F-001..F-005 (all fixed + re-verified in round 2 by four lanes): the primary remedy became evidence-first because the gap predicate is evidence coverage, and the printed ledger command carries FULL-REPLACE + PLAN-only caveats.
limitations: Warn mode cannot distinguish a legitimate same-session subagent reviewer from an owner self-sign (EXP-001 mechanical indistinguishability); the flag records the fact neutrally and enforce mode is reserved for hosts with per-thread session separation (e.g. Codex multi-thread). Session ids stay coordination-level (sessionSource records explicit-env overrides for audit); cryptographic reviewer identity is a different trust model owned by other work. provenanceFlag is audit-only in this story — no blocking gate consumes it yet.
pitfalls: 1) finding_resolve is REVIEW-phase-only — resolve findings after re-entering REVIEW, not from DEV. 2) forceReviewer mounts do not survive a DEV round-trip; re-run reviewer_list forceReviewer after each REVIEW re-entry. 3) milestone_ledger_set full-replace + PLAN-only: updating row display status mid-lifecycle is not worth a PLAN bounce since the DONE gate reads evidence coverage, not row status. 4) Signature-domain changes must be amend-vs-new-version decided from evidence: we scanned every review-passes.json under worktree + main before amending v3 in place (zero persisted records carried the new fields). 5) Story-metadata merge conflicts (checklist/index/process-events) after main merge resolve with --ours (branch copies are strict supersets).
